timeline.title: TIMELINE
timeline.helpText: Explore my story: each frame is a moment. Use
timeline.photo1Desc: This picture was taken on my very first day of school, a moment I remember very clearly. It was the first time I walked into a classroom full of people I didn’t know, and although I was nervous, there was also an excitement I’ll never forget. I had no idea what to expect, but that day marked the beginning of an important chapter in my life: making friends, learning new things, and starting to discover who I wanted to become.
timeline.photo2Desc: In this photo, we were preparing for a school play and, although I wanted a more serious role, I was assigned the jester. At the time, I was upset because I felt it didn’t fit me, but over time I learned to look back at it with humor. This experience taught me that sometimes unexpected roles help us grow and take things more lightly.
timeline.photo3Desc: This picture was taken on my 17th birthday, a day that became very special to me. Not only because I was celebrating another year of life, but because after a long time my whole family, from both my mom’s and dad’s side, came together again. It was a moment full of laughter, memories, and a sense of unity I hadn’t felt in years.
